Messages.Author: Orange Devil
Messages.Body:
Wider View
Master, no requirements, 1 pool
Master: Trifle
Put this card in play. You may use a transfer to move the top card
from your crypt to your uncontrolled region and then remove a crypt
card in your uncontrolled region from the game. You may use four
transfers to burn this card and gain 2 pool.

So, assuming this card text is correct, does this mean that once in
play you may pay a transfer to use the effect of the card as often as
you can pay transfers, or only once per Wider View put in play (or
something else)?

Thanks, also, awesome carddesign either way, love this card.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:

That card text indicates that it gets put into play. And that it gives
you an ability while in play.

Like Aimee Laroux, Maabara, Nkishi, Nosferatu Hosting, etc.

> Thanks, also, awesome carddesign either way, love this card.

Thank you.
